title: Second player's greedy choice
statement: Given a natural number $n$, a Boolean-valued winning condition $W$ on finite Boolean histories, and a history $h$, the second player's greedy choice is the Boolean negation of the first player's greedy choice at $h$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean-valued winning condition on finite Boolean histories
